field.name: holderGone
field.purpose: optional last parameter of takeOver and reclaim: says the recorded holder window's process and the lease's CLI are gone; takeOver of a lease of the claim's own windowKey (a reloaded window) is taken at once, and another window's only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS without a heartbeat; the dispose of a window keeps its presence row, which ages out over PRESENCE_GRACE_MS

rationale: S003 made takeover and reclaim take the liveness check from the worker and added the same-windowKey rule, so a reload does not wait ten minutes. Built and approved in S003.
